overview: New Westminster had 78,916 residents in 2021, up 11.2 percent from 70,996 in 2016, packed into just 15.62 square kilometres. Its 36,099 occupied homes are mostly apartments, and the median household income was $82,000 in 2020.

For a local business, that density means many customers within walking distance, but also many competitors on the same blocks. Royal Columbian Hospital, TransLink and the port anchor daytime employment, so commuters and health-care workers form a large share of weekday trade.

byService.website-development: Most New Westminster households live in apartments and move often, so a mobile-first website with clear delivery zones, booking and walking directions earns more conversions than a brochure site.
byService.branding: With a median household income of $82,000 in 2020, New Westminster buyers value good value; branding should feel approachable, rooted in the historic city and honest about pricing.
